title: Marketplaces
description: List your catalogue where people are already looking, and see what it brings in.
keepOf: They take {pct}% — you keep {net} of a {price} ticket.

empty.title: No marketplaces connected
empty.body: Connect one to list what you sell where people are already looking. You agree the commission with them; Counterfoil keeps the listings and the prices in step.

dialog.title: Connect a marketplace
dialog.body: Counterfoil keeps your listings and prices in step once you are connected.
dialog.firstBody: You need an approved supplier account with {name} and an agreed commission before this will do anything. Counterfoil does not apply on your behalf.
dialog.commissionHelp: What you agreed in your contract with them.
dialog.commissionBad: A commission has to be between 0 and 100%.
dialog.example: On a {price} ticket they keep {commission} and you get {net}.
dialog.apiKeyHelp: From their supplier site. Only the last four characters are kept here.
dialog.accountHelp: However they identify you — a supplier id or an email.

oneDescription: What {name} costs you, what is listed on it, and what it has brought in.
toMatchTitle: To take home what the counter takes
disconnectBody: Its {count, plural, one {# listing} other {# listings}} are removed with it. What has already sold is untouched, and you can connect again later.
sendDrafts: Send {count, plural, one {# draft} other {# drafts}} for review
submitted: {count, plural, one {# listing} other {# listings}} sent for review.

noListings.title: Nothing listed yet
noListings.body: Add the bookings you want {name} to sell.

add.title: Add a listing
add.body: Pick what you want this marketplace to sell.
